desc:
Shopify app review and cleanup is a careful audit of every app installed on your store, followed by safe removal of the ones you do not need. Ecom Swift LLC lists what each app costs and does, cleans leftover code from your theme, and tests the pages the apps touch.

## What is a Shopify app review?

A Shopify app review is a structured check of every app connected to your store. For each one we ask four things: what does it do, what does it cost each month, does your theme still use it, and could another app or a built-in Shopify feature do the same job.

Most stores collect apps over time. A review turns that pile into a short, clear list that shows what earns its place and what is only costing you money.

## Why unused apps cost more than their monthly fee

An app is not only a subscription. Many apps add scripts to your storefront, and those scripts load for every visitor, even on pages where the app does nothing. Several apps together can make product pages heavy and slow, and slow pages lose shoppers on a phone.

Uninstalling an app from the admin does not always remove what it left behind. Snippets, code blocks and stylesheet references can stay in your theme files. That leftover code can still load, can clash with other features, and makes later theme work harder and more expensive. A proper cleanup removes the app and its traces together.

## How a tidy app set helps your store

A smaller set of apps usually means faster pages, fewer clashes between features and a lower monthly bill. When two apps do the same thing, such as two review widgets or two pop-ups, shoppers see conflicting messages and your team has two places to manage. Merging them into one removes that friction.

There is a privacy side as well. Every app asks for permissions to read or change parts of your store. The fewer apps you keep, the fewer outside companies can reach your orders, customers and products. That is easier to explain to customers and easier for you to control.

## What a good app review includes

- A full list of installed apps, including ones that look inactive.
- The monthly cost and billing status of each app.
- A plain description of what each app does on the storefront and in the admin.
- A check of whether the app still shows up in your theme.
- A note on features that overlap with another app or with Shopify itself.
- Keep, replace or remove advice for every app, with the reason.
- A list of the permissions each app holds.
- Safe removal steps, including leftover snippets and code references.
- A test of the cart, checkout and key pages after each change.
- A one-page summary you can keep and share with your team.

## What we do

We start by joining your store as a collaborator or staff user and listing every app. We check each one against your theme and your daily use, then send you the advice before anything is removed.

Once you agree, we work on a duplicate of your theme where code is involved. We remove the apps in the safe order, clean the leftover theme code, and apply updates to the apps you keep. Then we test the home page, collection pages, product pages, cart and checkout on phone and desktop.

The Basic package covers the review and the written list. Standard adds removal, code cleanup, updates and testing. Premium goes further with extra removals, replacement apps where a gap appears, merged features and a permissions review.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Tell us which apps you know you rely on, so we treat them with extra care.
- Check your billing page in Shopify, so we can match costs to apps.
- Keep one app per job, such as one review tool and one email tool.
- Remove apps through a proper cleanup and not only from the admin list.
- Re-test your checkout after any app change.

**Avoid:**
- Deleting an app in a hurry before a sale, without a backup copy of your theme.
- Keeping an app only because you installed it once and forgot it.
- Installing a new app for every small request before checking built-in features.
- Granting every permission an app asks for without reading it.
- Removing a tool that your fulfilment or accounting depends on without checking first.

## Who this is for

This service suits store owners who have noticed their site feels slow and suspect their apps are part of the reason. It also suits owners who inherited a store from a previous developer and do not know why half the apps are there, and busy sellers who simply want the monthly bill to make sense. If you plan a redesign or a theme update, an app review first makes that job cleaner.

## What we need from you

Send us a collaborator request or staff invitation to your store, and tell us which apps matter most to your daily work. We never need your password, and we never ask for payment card details. If you want us to install a replacement app, tell us your preference or ask us for a short list of options. You pay app makers and Shopify directly, and our fixed-price package covers the work only. After you order, we send a short checklist and keep you updated until the summary is delivered.
